sar.narrative: Customer C11003, holder of card C11003-K2, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-20 04:08 and 2016-11-20 05:17, 3 transaction(s) totalling $1,399.95 were made on the card online from device profile 'iOS Device | iOS 11.1.2 | mobile safari generic | 2208x1242': $400.06 (3472547, 2016-11-20 04:08), $499.95 (3472599, 2016-11-20 05:04), $499.94 (3472608, 2016-11-20 05:17). Every amount sat just below $500 and the purchases were placed minutes apart, a pattern consistent with deliberately staying under an authorisation threshold. The activity is suspicious because: Case-memory model score 0.651; 3 online purchases within 69 minutes, each between $400 and $500 ($400.06, $499.95, $499.94; total $1,399.95). It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-4169, CC-4086, CC-3907. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placing linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retains the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.

stop_reason: Fraud probability 0.98 is at or above 0.85 with 3 independent pieces of evidence, so the decision is defensible without asking the customer (policy 6).
